description: The bar chart illustrates GLUE performance scores for different fine-tuning methods, shown separately for two RoBERTa model sizes. The horizontal axis contains the categorical fine-tuning methods labeled (left to right) Prefix, Adaptor, LoRA, BitFit, S₁-model, S₄-model, and S₅-model, with the axis label “Fine-tuning Method,” and the categories appear in this listed order without an indicated sorting rule. The vertical axis is labeled “GLUE Performance” and uses a linear scale with visible tick labels at 86 and 88 (implying a 2-point interval), spanning roughly the mid-84s up to just above 89. Each category has two adjacent bars: a blue bar for “base” and an orange bar for “large,” as indicated by the legend titled “RoBERTa Size” in the upper-left. Approximate values by method are: Prefix (base ≈84.6, large ≈85.7), Adaptor (base ≈84.4, large ≈88.1), LoRA (base ≈86.6, large ≈88.8), BitFit (base ≈84.3, large ≈87.7), S₁-model (base ≈85.6, large ≈85.6), S₄-model (base ≈86.2, large ≈87.6), and S₅-model (base ≈87.0, large ≈89.1). The shortest bar appears to be the BitFit base bar (just above 84), and the tallest bar appears to be the S₅-model large bar (a little above 89). No bars are visually emphasized with annotations, outlines, or special shading beyond the two color encodings.
